description: ONS publishes operating-hour parameters used to calculate equivalent forced and scheduled unavailability rates. The dictionary distinguishes plant and generating-unit identifiers, period, input type, parameter value and rate version. These inputs support reliability-rate reconstruction and plant-availability studies. They are calculation inputs, distinct from the published rate outcomes. Period length and unit-specific completeness must be checked before combining values. Coverage is generating plants and units in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS TEIFa/TEIP rates provide the separately catalogued unavailability product.
